schema:
# Wrfcoin GraphQL Schema
# Comprehensive GraphQL API for the Wrfcoin ecosystem
# Supports all smart contracts, blockchain operations, and data models

# Scalar types
scalar DateTime
scalar BigInt
scalar Bytes32
scalar Address
scalar WeiAmount

# Core token information
type WRFToken {
  id: ID!
  address: Address!
  symbol: String!
  name: String!
  decimals: Int!
  totalSupply: WeiAmount!
  maxSupply: WeiAmount!
  paused: Boolean!
  
  # Weather station rewards
  weatherRewardRate: WeiAmount!
  weatherStations: [WeatherStation!]!
  
  # Governance features
  votes: [Vote!]!
  proposals: [GovernanceProposal!]!
}

# Weather stations and data
type WeatherStation {
  id: ID!
  address: Address!
  stationId: String!
  location: String!
  isActive: Boolean!
  lastRewardTime: DateTime
  totalRewards: WeiAmount!
  qualityScore: Float!
  
  # Weather data
  weatherData: [WeatherData!]!
  latestWeatherData: WeatherData
}

type WeatherData {
  id: ID!
  stationId: String!
  timestamp: DateTime!
  temperature: Float! # In celsius * 100
  humidity: Float! # 0-100%
  pressure: Float! # In hPa * 100
  windSpeed: Float! # In m/s * 100
  rainfall: Float! # In mm * 100
  confidence: Float! # 0-100%
  
  station: WeatherStation!
}

# Carbon credits and environmental data
type CarbonCredit {
  id: ID!
  tokenId: BigInt!
  carbonOffset: BigInt! # CO2 equivalent in grams
  projectType: String!
  verificationStandard: String!
  issuanceDate: DateTime!
  expiryDate: DateTime!
  location: String!
  isRetired: Boolean!
  issuer: Address!
  certificationHash: String!
  
  # Trading information
  forSale: Boolean!
  price: WeiAmount
  owner: Address!
  
  # Marketplace data
  transfers: [CarbonCreditTransfer!]!
  retirements: [CarbonCreditRetirement!]!
}

type CarbonCreditTransfer {
  id: ID!
  tokenId: BigInt!
  from: Address!
  to: Address!
  price: WeiAmount
  timestamp: DateTime!
  transactionHash: String!
}

type CarbonCreditRetirement {
  id: ID!
  tokenId: BigInt!
  retiringEntity: Address!
  carbonOffset: BigInt!
  timestamp: DateTime!
  transactionHash: String!
}

# Computational NFTs
type ComputationalNFT {
  id: ID!
  tokenId: BigInt!
  modelType: ModelType!
  modelName: String!
  inputData: String!
  computeResources: String!
  executionTime: BigInt!
  stakeAmount: WeiAmount!
  status: ComputeStatus!
  resultData: String
  resultHash: String
  createdAt: DateTime!
  executedAt: DateTime
  computeProvider: Address
  isVerified: Boolean!
  
  owner: Address!
  job: ComputeJob!
}

enum ModelType {
  WEATHER_FORECAST
  CLIMATE_MODEL
  AIR_QUALITY
  CARBON_ANALYSIS
}

enum ComputeStatus {
  CREATED
  QUEUED
  EXECUTING
  COMPLETED
  FAILED
}

type ComputeJob {
  id: ID!
  nft: ComputationalNFT!
  provider: ComputeProvider
  rewards: [ComputeReward!]!
}

type ComputeProvider {
  id: ID!
  address: Address!
  isAuthorized: Boolean!
  totalComputeTime: BigInt!
  successfulJobs: BigInt!
  failedJobs: BigInt!
  stakedTokens: WeiAmount!
  hardwareSpecs: String!
  
  jobs: [ComputeJob!]!
}

type ComputeReward {
  id: ID!
  provider: Address!
  amount: WeiAmount!
  computeTime: BigInt!
  timestamp: DateTime!
  transactionHash: String!
}

# Governance system
type GovernanceProposal {
  id: ID!
  proposalId: BigInt!
  title: String!
  description: String!
  proposer: Address!
  targets: [Address!]!
  values: [WeiAmount!]!
  calldatas: [String!]!
  
  # Voting configuration
  votingType: VotingType!
  votingDelay: BigInt!
  votingPeriod: BigInt!
  quorumFraction: BigInt!
  emergencyProposal: Boolean!
  
  # State
  state: ProposalState!
  startBlock: BigInt!
  endBlock: BigInt!
  forVotes: WeiAmount!
  againstVotes: WeiAmount!
  abstainVotes: WeiAmount!
  
  # Votes
  votes: [Vote!]!
  
  # Timestamps
  createdAt: DateTime!
  executedAt: DateTime
}

enum VotingType {
  SIMPLE_MAJORITY
  QUADRATIC
  RANKED_CHOICE
  FRACTIONAL
}

enum ProposalState {
  PENDING
  ACTIVE
  CANCELED
  DEFEATED
  SUCCEEDED
  QUEUED
  EXPIRED
  EXECUTED
}

type Vote {
  id: ID!
  proposalId: BigInt!
  voter: Address!
  support: VoteChoice!
  weight: WeiAmount!
  reason: String
  timestamp: DateTime!
  transactionHash: String!
  
  # Voting type specific data
  quadraticCredits: BigInt
  rankedChoices: [Int!]
  fractionalVotes: FractionalVote
}

enum VoteChoice {
  AGAINST
  FOR
  ABSTAIN
}

type FractionalVote {
  forVotes: WeiAmount!
  againstVotes: WeiAmount!
  abstainVotes: WeiAmount!
}

# Carbon credit AMM and trading
type CarbonCreditAMM {
  id: ID!
  address: Address!
  token0: Address!
  token1: Address!
  reserve0: WeiAmount!
  reserve1: WeiAmount!
  feeBasisPoints: Int!
  protocolFeeBasisPoints: Int!
  totalSupply: WeiAmount!
  
  # Price information
  price0CumulativeLast: BigInt!
  price1CumulativeLast: BigInt!
  kLast: BigInt!
  
  # Trading activity
  swaps: [Swap!]!
  mints: [Mint!]!
  burns: [Burn!]!
  flashLoans: [FlashLoan!]!
}

type Swap {
  id: ID!
  pool: CarbonCreditAMM!
  sender: Address!
  to: Address!
  amount0In: WeiAmount!
  amount1In: WeiAmount!
  amount0Out: WeiAmount!
  amount1Out: WeiAmount!
  timestamp: DateTime!
  transactionHash: String!
}

type Mint {
  id: ID!
  pool: CarbonCreditAMM!
  sender: Address!
  amount0: WeiAmount!
  amount1: WeiAmount!
  liquidity: WeiAmount!
  timestamp: DateTime!
  transactionHash: String!
}

type Burn {
  id: ID!
  pool: CarbonCreditAMM!
  sender: Address!
  to: Address!
  amount0: WeiAmount!
  amount1: WeiAmount!
  liquidity: WeiAmount!
  timestamp: DateTime!
  transactionHash: String!
}

type FlashLoan {
  id: ID!
  pool: CarbonCreditAMM!
  borrower: Address!
  amount0: WeiAmount!
  amount1: WeiAmount!
  fee0: WeiAmount!
  fee1: WeiAmount!
  timestamp: DateTime!
  transactionHash: String!
}

# User accounts and activity
type User {
  id: ID!
  address: Address!
  
  # Token balances
  wrfBalance: WeiAmount!
  carbonCredits: [CarbonCredit!]!
  computationalNFTs: [ComputationalNFT!]!
  
  # Activity
  carbonFootprint: CarbonFootprint
  votes: [Vote!]!
  proposals: [GovernanceProposal!]!
  weatherStations: [WeatherStation!]!
  
  # Trading activity
  swaps: [Swap!]!
  liquidityPositions: [LiquidityPosition!]!
  
  # Staking and rewards
  stakingPositions: [StakingPosition!]!
  rewards: [Reward!]!
}

type CarbonFootprint {
  id: ID!
  user: Address!
  totalEmissions: Float! # kg CO2e
  totalOffsets: Float! # kg CO2e
  netEmissions: Float! # kg CO2e
  calculationDate: DateTime!
  
  activities: [CarbonActivity!]!
  recommendations: [CarbonRecommendation!]!
}

type CarbonActivity {
  id: ID!
  user: Address!
  activityType: CarbonActivityType!
  category: String!
  amount: Float!
  unit: String!
  carbonEmission: Float! # kg CO2e
  confidence: Float!
  source: String!
  timestamp: DateTime!
  location: Location
}

enum CarbonActivityType {
  TRANSPORTATION
  ENERGY
  FOOD
  DIGITAL
}

type Location {
  latitude: Float
  longitude: Float
}

type CarbonRecommendation {
  id: ID!
  user: Address!
  title: String!
  description: String!
  potentialSavings: Float! # kg CO2e
  priority: String!
  category: String!
  generatedAt: DateTime!
}

type LiquidityPosition {
  id: ID!
  user: Address!
  pool: CarbonCreditAMM!
  liquidity: WeiAmount!
  token0Amount: WeiAmount!
  token1Amount: WeiAmount!
  createdAt: DateTime!
  updatedAt: DateTime!
}

type StakingPosition {
  id: ID!
  user: Address!
  amount: WeiAmount!
  lockDuration: BigInt!
  rewardRate: WeiAmount!
  stakedAt: DateTime!
  unlocksAt: DateTime!
  claimed: Boolean!
}

type Reward {
  id: ID!
  user: Address!
  type: RewardType!
  amount: WeiAmount!
  source: String!
  timestamp: DateTime!
  transactionHash: String!
}

enum RewardType {
  WEATHER_DATA
  COMPUTE_PROVISION
  STAKING
  GOVERNANCE
  CARBON_OFFSET
}

# Analytics and market data
type MarketData {
  id: ID!
  timestamp: DateTime!
  
  # Token prices
  wrfPrice: Float!
  wrfMarketCap: Float!
  wrfVolume24h: Float!
  
  # Carbon credit market
  carbonCreditVolume24h: Float!
  averageCarbonPrice: Float!
  totalCarbonCredits: BigInt!
  retiredCarbonCredits: BigInt!
  
  # Network statistics
  totalUsers: BigInt!
  activeWeatherStations: BigInt!
  computeJobs24h: BigInt!
  totalValueLocked: Float!
}

# Query root type
type Query {
  # Token information
  wrfToken: WRFToken
  
  # Weather data
  weatherStation(id: ID!): WeatherStation
  weatherStations(
    first: Int = 10
    skip: Int = 0
    orderBy: String = "id"
    orderDirection: String = "asc"
    where: WeatherStationFilter
  ): [WeatherStation!]!
  
  weatherData(
    stationId: String!
    from: DateTime
    to: DateTime
    first: Int = 100
  ): [WeatherData!]!
  
  # Carbon credits
  carbonCredit(id: ID!): CarbonCredit
  carbonCredits(
    first: Int = 10
    skip: Int = 0
    orderBy: String = "id"
    orderDirection: String = "asc"
    where: CarbonCreditFilter
  ): [CarbonCredit!]!
  
  # Computational NFTs
  computationalNFT(id: ID!): ComputationalNFT
  computationalNFTs(
    first: Int = 10
    skip: Int = 0
    orderBy: String = "id"
    orderDirection: String = "asc"
    where: ComputationalNFTFilter
  ): [ComputationalNFT!]!
  
  # Governance
  proposal(id: ID!): GovernanceProposal
  proposals(
    first: Int = 10
    skip: Int = 0
    orderBy: String = "id"
    orderDirection: String = "asc"
    where: ProposalFilter
  ): [GovernanceProposal!]!
  
  # AMM and trading
  ammPool(id: ID!): CarbonCreditAMM
  ammPools(
    first: Int = 10
    skip: Int = 0
  ): [CarbonCreditAMM!]!
  
  # Users
  user(address: Address!): User
  users(
    first: Int = 10
    skip: Int = 0
  ): [User!]!
  
  # Analytics
  marketData(timestamp: DateTime): MarketData
  marketDataHistory(
    from: DateTime!
    to: DateTime!
    interval: String = "1h"
  ): [MarketData!]!
  
  # Search
  search(query: String!, type: SearchType): [SearchResult!]!
}

# Mutation root type
type Mutation {
  # Weather data
  submitWeatherData(input: WeatherDataInput!): WeatherDataSubmissionResult!
  
  # Carbon tracking
  trackCarbonActivity(input: CarbonActivityInput!): CarbonActivityResult!
  
  # Voting
  castVote(input: VoteInput!): VoteResult!
  
  # Trading (via signed transactions)
  prepareSwap(input: SwapInput!): TransactionPreparation!
  prepareTransfer(input: TransferInput!): TransactionPreparation!
  prepareStake(input: StakeInput!): TransactionPreparation!
}

# Subscription root type
type Subscription {
  # Real-time updates
  weatherDataUpdated(stationId: String): WeatherData!
  newCarbonCredit: CarbonCredit!
  newComputeJob: ComputationalNFT!
  newProposal: GovernanceProposal!
  swapExecuted(pool: Address): Swap!
  
  # Market updates
  priceUpdated(token: Address): PriceUpdate!
  
  # User-specific updates
  userActivityUpdated(address: Address!): UserActivity!
}

# Input types
input WeatherDataInput {
  stationId: String!
  temperature: Float!
  humidity: Float!
  pressure: Float!
  windSpeed: Float!
  rainfall: Float!
  confidence: Float!
  signature: String!
}

input CarbonActivityInput {
  userId: String!
  activityType: CarbonActivityType!
  category: String!
  amount: Float!
  unit: String!
  source: String = "manual"
  location: LocationInput
}

input LocationInput {
  latitude: Float!
  longitude: Float!
}

input VoteInput {
  proposalId: BigInt!
  support: VoteChoice!
  reason: String
  signature: String!
}

input SwapInput {
  tokenIn: Address!
  tokenOut: Address!
  amountIn: String!
  amountOutMin: String!
  deadline: BigInt!
  slippageTolerance: Float!
}

input TransferInput {
  tokenId: BigInt!
  to: Address!
  amount: String!
}

input StakeInput {
  amount: String!
  lockDuration: BigInt!
}

# Filter input types
input WeatherStationFilter {
  isActive: Boolean
  location_contains: String
  qualityScore_gte: Float
}

input CarbonCreditFilter {
  projectType: String
  verificationStandard: String
  isRetired: Boolean
  forSale: Boolean
  issuer: Address
}

input ComputationalNFTFilter {
  modelType: ModelType
  status: ComputeStatus
  owner: Address
  isVerified: Boolean
}

input ProposalFilter {
  state: ProposalState
  proposer: Address
  votingType: VotingType
  emergencyProposal: Boolean
}

# Result types
type WeatherDataSubmissionResult {
  success: Boolean!
  weatherData: WeatherData
  rewards: WeiAmount
  error: String
}

type CarbonActivityResult {
  success: Boolean!
  activity: CarbonActivity
  carbonEmission: Float!
  recommendations: [CarbonRecommendation!]!
  error: String
}

type VoteResult {
  success: Boolean!
  vote: Vote
  transactionHash: String
  error: String
}

type TransactionPreparation {
  success: Boolean!
  transactionData: String!
  gasEstimate: String!
  nonce: BigInt!
  error: String
}

# Search types
enum SearchType {
  ALL
  USERS
  CARBON_CREDITS
  PROPOSALS
  WEATHER_STATIONS
  COMPUTE_JOBS
}

union SearchResult = User | CarbonCredit | GovernanceProposal | WeatherStation | ComputationalNFT

# Event types for subscriptions
type PriceUpdate {
  token: Address!
  price: Float!
  change24h: Float!
  timestamp: DateTime!
}

type UserActivity {
  user: Address!
  type: String!
  data: String!
  timestamp: DateTime!
}
